_README: 8.16 (PENDING.md): table VALUES whose cell or row carries a CONDITION. Each case requires the number AND the condition, in the manual's words (any-of lists allow the manual's own alternatives). Measured before any fix on 2026-09-29; see PENDING 8.16.

cases.q: What percentage of Thai 50 Satang coins can the SMART Coin System hold before it dumps them to the cashbox?
cases.reference: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p.64-65, Small Coins: THB 50 Satang 15% of all coins, or max 20 coins if no other coins in device -- whichever is greater.

cases.q: What's the limit for Euro 1 cent coins in the SMART Coin System hopper?
cases.reference: Same table: EUR 0.01, 25% of all coins, max 20 coins if no other coins in device -- whichever is greater.

cases.q: How much current does the MyCheckr draw at maximum load on a 12V supply?
cases.reference: MyCheckr User Manual-v7.pdf p.38 Supply Currents, Max Load row: 12VDC RMS 1.10A, peak 1.35A -- condition: as Max Operating (scanning for faces) but also both USB Type-A ports drawing 0.5A each.

cases.q: What is the maximum note length the NV9 Spectral accepts?
cases.reference: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p.28 Notes: max length 167 mm, but 160 mm with the Multi Note Float.

cases.q: What voltage does the SMART Hopper treat as logic high on its inputs?
cases.reference: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p.22 Interface Logic Levels: Inputs logic high = 3.7V min (internal pullup); logic low 0V to +0.5V.

cases.q: What's the maximum supply voltage for the MyCheckr?
cases.reference: MyCheckr User Manual-v7.pdf p.37 Supply Voltages: V IN maximum 26.4VDC (+10%); minimum 10.8VDC (-10%); nominal 12-24VDC.
